policy: Route-level live-state confidence doorplates turn field freshness, missing values, stale values, and recognition quality into explicit confidence penalties before final strategy composition.

confidence_score_contract.subtract_missing_penalty_points: sum missing_penalty_points for missing required fields
confidence_score_contract.subtract_recognition_penalty_points: recognized_state.confidence below 0.75 subtracts 15 points when available

route_policy.must_ask_when_below_threshold: Ask only for the smallest missing/stale field set that can change the top decision.
route_policy.allow_fast_answer_when: confidence_after_live_state >= ask_threshold or time_left is too low and action is reversible
